title: Squid Optimize
description: Achieve better performance without any gimmicks.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c03019a3e9a36a9b9956d20d226af2d5fa675f88.png)

## Purpose
**Squid Optimize** is a performance driven modpack that provides a refined Minecraft experience with a focus on optimization. Its core principle is to enhance performance by reducing lag and increasing frame rates, ensuring that players can enjoy a smooth and uninterrupted gameplay experience. Additionally, this modpack includes custom textures and models that enhance the visual appeal of the game.

## Why Squid Optimize?
What sets Sqid Optimize apart from other modpacks is its commitment to keeping the game pure vanilla. It doesn’t add any wild changes or gimmicks, but rather improves on the existing  graphics so that the game runs more smoothly. With the help of carefully selected mods that improve system performance, you can set large render distants, play all types of servers without the usual performance issues that can get in the way of the fun.

**If you encounter any issues, please reach out to me at discord ( @Zya4d ).**
